Quality & Fabrication Safety

Specify clearly. Fabricate safely. Document every shipment.

Crystalline silica safety

Cutting, grinding, drilling, or polishing stone can generate respirable crystalline silica dust. Fabricators must use effective wet methods, local exhaust ventilation, approved respiratory protection, exposure controls, training, and housekeeping required by applicable law and the product SDS.

Wholesale & Export Program

Clear buying steps for distributors, builders, designers, and project buyers.

01

Sample & Material Review

Choose from marble, granite, quartz, and engineered marble samples. We can prepare labeled sample kits for showroom, contractor, and project approval.

02

Quote By Drawing Or Size

Send dimensions, edge profile, sink/cutout drawings, finish, quantity, and destination. We will match the material and production route.

03

MOQ & Lead Time

Typical MOQ starts from 10-20 pieces per style or color. Sample kits ship faster; production orders usually require 25-55 days depending on complexity.

04

Inspection & Packaging

Each piece is checked for size, finish, edge, cutouts, and surface quality, then packed with foam, corner guards, cartons, and export plywood crates.
